children: The Central Bank of Armenia raised its benchmark interest rate to 6.75% in September 2026 from 6.5% previously, tightening monetary policy as inflation remained above the Bank’s 3% target.
The deposit rate was increased to 5.25%, while the lending rate rose to 8.25%.
Annual inflation eased to 4.4% in August from 4.5% in July, marking the lowest level since May, while core inflation edged up to 4.8% from a year earlier.
Meanwhile, Armenia’s economy expanded 6.7% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, accelerating from an upwardly revised 5.2% growth in the previous quarter.
The rate increase came as the Bank continued to balance persistent inflationary pressures against strong domestic economic activity.

title: Armenia Raises Policy Rate to 6.75%
